description: This file sets up ESLint configuration for a project, utilizing the '@eslint/eslintrc' package and the 'FlatCompat' utility to extend certain base configurations. It constructs an ESLint config array by extending 'next/core-web-vitals' and 'next/typescript'.

classes.name: FlatCompat
classes.description: A class imported from '@eslint/eslintrc' used to facilitate extending configuration files.

methods.name: extends
methods.description: Method of FlatCompat that returns an array of extended configurations based on provided extension names.
